int_name: N BROAD ST & W CLEARFIELD ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban roadway with a marked continental crosswalk. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance across four lanes of traffic without a median refuge or signalization creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks traffic signals or stop signs despite the high number of travel lanes, which can lead to multiple-threat crashes.
hazards.location_in_image: Marked crosswalk across the four-lane road

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to the crossing signs to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled location.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a high-visibility continental crosswalk, but it lacks a pedestrian refuge island or median. The environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle infrastructure with minimal separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a commercial area with marked crosswalks and sidewalks. However, the pedestrian environment is compromised by faded pavement markings, wide turning radii, and a lack of high-visibility crossing treatments.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center across the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner near the KFC has a wide radius that allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement in the intersection area can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.
